Renal warm ischemia over 30 minutes during laparoscopic partial nephrectomy is a possible complication that can occur. While the results of our study demonstrate that kidney damage occurs during this time frame, efforts should be made to keep warm ischemia within 30 minutes.

This means that if you're considering undergoing a laparoscopic partial nephrectomy, it's essential to discuss your risk factors and potential complications with your surgeon. They can help determine the best course of action for your individual situation and ensure that any necessary precautions are taken to minimize the risk of renal warm ischemia.
